name: incident-copilot
description: On-call incident copilot. Name an incident (link or id) or a service that is alerting, and in about two minutes it builds one incident card: what is broken, when it started, a UTC timeline, the top 3 suspect deploys or merged PRs ranked in code by how close they landed to the start, whether their changed files appear in the error stack traces, and when errors began, plus similar past incidents with how they were fixed and the runbook link. It reads your connected alerting, metrics, logs, error tracking, code host and documents, says plainly which sources were missing, and never invents a cause. On request it posts the card to the incident's chat channel, optionally tagging the top suspect's author, only after you approve that exact card and that exact person. Runs on demand in chat; it never acknowledges, resolves or rolls back anything.

skills.name: Incident card
skills.description: One incident card for a firing alert: what's broken, start time, timeline, top suspect changes with evidence, similar past incidents and their fixes, runbook, and what could not be checked. Then, on approval, posted to the incident's chat channel.
examples: What broke in incident INC-4821? It started 20 minutes ago.
Post the card to #inc-4821 and tag the author of the top suspect.
